name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: A number between the two buttons that step it.
use: A small number a reader nudges more often than types: seats, a quantity, a font size, a price. It is an input group around a native number input; min, max and step are written once, on the field, and the script makes the two buttons call stepDown() and stepUp(). A figure with a unit, a currency or grouping is written by Intl.NumberFormat into a stepper-display while the field is not focused, and a stepper-scrub handle or label steps the number as it is dragged sideways, as in a design tool.

instead.when: The number is typed once and rarely adjusted, such as a port or a price
The value is a position in a wide range, where the exact figure matters less
The choice is among a few named amounts

keyboard.action: Step the value by step and stop at min and max, as a number input does
Step ten steps for each step the drag moves

platform.fallback: The field keeps the width of --stepper-min instead of following the digits typed
A scrub with a mouse captures the pointer instead, and stops stepping where the pointer meets the edge of the screen

classes.name: stepper
classes.description: On an input-group: a well as wide as its figure, with a button at each end. A button disabled at its limit lies flat in the well

classes.name: stepper-field
classes.description: On the group's input-group-field, a native number input: centered tabular figures, no spin buttons

classes.name: stepper-value
classes.description: Around the field and its stepper-display: one cell as wide as the wider of the two. While the field is not focused and the display has a figure, the field's own digits are clear

classes.name: stepper-display
classes.description: In a stepper-value after the field, with aria-hidden="true": the figure as Intl.NumberFormat writes it, shown in the field's place while the field is not focused. The behavior writes it

classes.name: stepper-scrub
classes.description: A handle in the well, or a label of the field anywhere in the page, that steps the number as it is dragged sideways: an ew-resize cursor, and no text selection

properties.name: --stepper-min
properties.description: The narrowest the figure's box gets

properties.name: --stepper-max
properties.description: The widest it grows with field-sizing
